[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=209 }} The [[Mourning Veil Falls]] area is named after a [[Mourning Veil Falls (landmark)|low waterfall]] bearing the same name, on the [[Rijeka River]] which is said to be flowing with the essence of the [[Echovald Forest]]. The Rijeka River cascades along in a series of waterfall across the southern end of the forest, heading out to the ocean. ==Getting there== The fastest way to get here is to exit southwest from [[Durheim Archives]] (southeast of [[Vasburg Armory]]). This [[explorable area]] is completely optional and is bypassed by the main storyline. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s with [[bounty|bounties]]: *[[Kurzick Priest]] → [[Blessing of the
